character.randomization: Final score = sum × random integer in [5, 14]. Highest score wins.

roleScoring.note: Role bonuses stack on top of city/family scoring, regardless of family affiliation.

rules.label: Governor of a city with this religion (not the holy city)
Agent in a city with this religion (not the holy city)

threshold.description: A random integer 1..3 is drawn at the start of evaluation. Each religion's city-based + role-based score must be **strictly greater than** the threshold to be eligible. The highest post-modifier score among eligible religions wins; ties go nowhere.

whoRolls: Leader characters of human players never auto-convert (`isHuman() && isLeader()`).
Anyone who already has a religion is skipped (`hasReligion()` check).
Religion heads, characters with NoReligion trait, and anyone under age 10 (TUTORS_AGE) are ineligible.
Non-leaders with a 'locked religion' trait can only convert to that locked religion.
No conversion before turn 10 of the game (CHARACTER_RELIGION_DELAY_TURNS).
Per turn, each eligible character rolls a 10% chance (CHARACTER_RELIGION_PROB).
Adults always proceed after the 10% gate. Children (age < 18) proceed with probability 1 / (ADULT_AGE − age + 1). At age 10 that's 1/9; at 17, 1/2. Adulthood = 18.
